subject: Contracting runbook & evaluation MAP — roles, redlines, target close
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmehealth.com>, Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Contracting runbook & evaluation MAP — roles, redlines, target close

Hi Lena / team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited about the opportunity to pilot Redwood for the Acme Health analytics workspace. I put together an initial contracting runbook + mutual action plan (attached) that lays out the evaluation milestones, decision criteria, and the contracting steps we typically see for health systems. High-level asks in this email:

- Confirm the primary contracting owner at Acme and who will drive redlines (we typically coordinate with Procurement + Legal).
- Agree on the evaluation success criteria and a target signature date so we can prioritize resources.
- Pick a 30–45 minute sync next week to walk through the MAP and SOW.

Key dates proposed in the attached MAP-Draft-v0.9.pdf:
1) Technical evaluation (trial/POC) window: Nov 22 — Dec 4
2) Procurement review & redlines: Dec 6 — Dec 16
3) Final exec signoff / signature target: Dec 22

Roles we suggest from Redwood:
- Aditya Rao (AE) — commercial lead / deal owner
- Laura Bennett (Sr. Counsel) — terms + redline owner for Redwood
- Stephanie Nguyen (Sales Ops) — SOW template and billing cadence

Attachments: MAP-Draft-v0.9.pdf (MAP + milestones), Acme-SOW-template.docx (Redwood SOW scaffold).

If that timeline looks broadly achievable, I can lock a slot for a runbook review Wednesday 11/24 or Thursday 11/25 morning PT.

Thanks,

—Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: MAP-Draft-v0.9.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: Acme-SOW-template.docx (DOCX)

From: Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@acmehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contracting runbook & evaluation MAP — roles, redlines, target close

Aditya,

Thanks for sending — the plan is helpful. Quick answers from our side: Marcus (Procurement) will own contract intake and working the redlines; I will coordinate with Legal but will be your point for procurement cadence. Sara will run the technical eval and provide the POC acceptance checklist.

A couple notes from Procurement:
- We need the Redwood standard data processing addendum and SOC 2 attestation early in the review.
- Our internal approval committee meets Dec 18 — if redlines are completed by Dec 16, we can make the Dec 22 signature target work, otherwise it will slip to early Jan.

Can Laura (Redwood legal) share the expected redline turnaround and whether you use DocuSign or redline-in-Word first? Also happy to take the MAP and suggest small scheduling changes if needed.

Best,
Marcus Bell
Director of Procurement — Acme Health
marcus.bell@acmehealth.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@acmehealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contracting runbook & evaluation MAP — roles, redlines, target close

Marcus / Lena — thanks for the quick response. I'm Laura, Sr. Counsel at Redwood; I'll be the primary terms/redline owner on our side. A few process points to keep things moving smoothly:

- Preferred redline flow: initial redline in Word (track changes) -> one round of back-and-forth -> final DocuSign packet. This tends to be fastest for health/legal teams.
- I will attach Redwood's standard DPA and SOC 2 attestation to the Doc workspace (link below) and can pre-seed a few contract rows we typically see requested (data residency, breach notice timeline).
- Our typical turnaround for a single redline round is 3 business days from receipt; if we need parallel technical/legal loops we should flag that in the MAP.

Proposed contracting milestones (I'll include these in the MAP):
1) Procurement initial review (redline intake): Dec 6
2) Redwood first-pass comments: Dec 9
3) Final redlines agreed / DocuSign prep: Dec 16
4) Signature target: Dec 22

I moved the runbook review to Thu 2026-11-25 10:00 AM PT (inv coming from me) so we can go line-by-line on the evaluation checklist + contracting assumptions.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0140

Links:
- MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEF-MAP-Acme
- Redwood SOC 2 (attestation): https://redwood.com/security/soc2-2026.pdf

Attachment: Redwood-DPA-v2.1.docx (DOCX)

From: Lena Park <lena.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contracting runbook & evaluation MAP — roles, redlines, target close

All,

That looks good to me — appreciated the clarity and the proposed milestones. Confirming: Marcus will own procurement intake, Sara will run the POC checklist, Laura will handle Redwood redlines, Aditya will track commercial/exec signoff.

Couple of asks from our side before the runbook review on Thursday:
- Please include a short acceptance criteria page in the MAP that Sara can sign off on after the POC (this will speed approvals).
- Can Redwood share the SOC 2 attestation and DPA link in the calendar invite?

I'll see you all on Thu 11/25 at 10:00 AM PT. Thanks — looking forward to a smooth path to close.

Best,
Lena Park
Director, Clinical Analytics — Acme Health
lena.park@acmehealth.com
